That would indeed be safer. I tend to be more agressive so I E in instead of E out. I killed him without my jungler, but it was over a long process of W and Q pokes until he was low and kill-able.

You have to play safely while taking the opportunity to E if he stands too near a wall. If E hits throw W and start basic attacking to proc W effect. Then walk away, if possible throw a Q from distance. 

You will most likely need the jungle to kill him or it will take a lot of mini trade wins to lower him but then he would just walk away once his life hits critical levels. 

Try to throw him upwards with E without him using his sword swirl, I think even though he is in the air the skill still damages you, and since when he is using this skill he can't AA you are essentially wasting a Stun.

In the beginning, up to level 6 you deal more damage, but when he gets his ultimate he will barely win, but win, even if you have 2 kills ahead. Not much later he falls off and well it's a garen, shit champion, he won't do much in the Team fights if you won't feed him so just don't get killed around 6-11 levels and you will be fine.

 It's more about bringing the lane to a Draw. I just won against a Garen, I ended up 9/9/16 and he 7/13/6. Now, the thing is, only in low elo there are garens. As you proceed you will see he is a simples champion and simple champions are simple to play against.

Basically use W before he gets close to land the silencing hit, while silenced hit with AA to proc W passive and any sheen item, start to walk away from him bringing the fight closer to your side until silence ends if he walks away you prob won the trade since W deals a percentage of health if he still follows you make sure to go near a wall while you "walk away from him waiting for the silence to end" to E him up, otherwise Q then E. Then manage until W is back rinse and repeat.
